column3: With your realm destroyed by undead, the only way to gain enough power to drive them back someday is to capture castle Visimir!!!!
column4: They destroyed the entire land, killing everything living.  The Necromancer King was bent on destroying everything.  Our land has been defiled, now nothing grows where fertile farmland once was.  There was never any fight.  Our Warlock-Sorceress alliance was too young to form an army.  Now, the remainder of us are forced to flee, maybe someday to return in search of vengeance!!!
column5: 奴らは大地をことごとく破壊し、すべての命を奪った。ネクロマンサー王は、何もかも滅ぼすつもりだったのだ。国土は穢され、かつて肥沃な農地だった場所には、もう何も育たない。戦いにすらならなかった。ウォーロックとソーサレスの同盟はまだ若く、軍を整える暇さえなかった。生き残った者たちは逃げるほかない。いつの日かこの地に戻り、復讐を果たすために……！

column3: With your realm destroyed by undead, the only way to gain enough power to drive them back someday is to capture castle Visimir!!!!
column4: A Barbarian ship appears as the sun rises. When they dock, they say "We do not believe your lies.  You will not deceive us again! The last thing we would do is ally with you!" He then runs back to his ship, and throws a sack containing your diplomats head onto the shore.  Now, it is clear what you must do-destroy the Barbarians at all costs!!!
column5: 夜明けとともに、バーバリアンの船が姿を現した。接岸すると、一人の男が叫ぶ。「お前たちの嘘など信じるものか。二度と我々を欺くことはできん！ お前たちと同盟を結ぶなど、断じてありえない！」男は船へ駆け戻り、あなたの外交官の首が入った袋を岸へ投げ捨てた。やるべきことは、もはや明らかだ。どんな犠牲を払ってでも、バーバリアンを滅ぼせ！

column3: With your realm destroyed by undead, the only way to gain enough power to drive them back someday is to capture castle Visimir!!!!
column4: It seems as if luck has given you hope in defeating the evil hordes that now inhabit your land.  They have no idea there are still armies from Alteris alive.  You now have time to form an invasion to take your homeland back!!
column5: どうやら運が味方したようだ。故郷を占拠する邪悪な大軍を打ち破る望みが見えてきた。敵は、アルテリスの軍勢がまだ生き残っていることを知らない。今なら侵攻軍を整え、故郷を取り戻せる！

column3: With your realm destroyed by undead, the only way to gain enough power to drive them back someday is to capture castle Visimir!!!!
column4: You must take castle Visimir quickly! Your resources are running out, and soon the Necromancers will be exploring the sea!  If you combine Visimir with the castles you already own, there is a chance to avenge your countrymen!!!
column5: 急いでヴィシミール城を奪え！ 資源は尽きかけ、ネクロマンサーもじきに海へ探索の手を伸ばす。ヴィシミールと、すでに所有する城々の力を合わせれば、同胞の仇を討てるかもしれない！

column3: With your realm destroyed by undead, the only way to gain enough power to drive them back someday is to capture castle Visimir!!!!
column4: What are you still doing here??  You are surrounded!!!  You must flee now and set up a new kingdom, because soon the Necromancers will be scouting even the seas!!!
column5: まだここで何をしている？ すでに包囲されているぞ！ 今すぐ脱出し、新たな王国を築くのだ。ネクロマンサーはまもなく、海にまで偵察の手を伸ばしてくる！

column3: With your realm destroyed by undead, the only way to gain enough power to drive them back someday is to capture castle Visimir!!!!
column4: After consulting with your advisors you agree you have about one year at the absolute most before the Necromancers would have complete control.  You will have to be very powerful by then.
column5: 助言者たちと協議を重ねた末、結論が出た。ネクロマンサーが完全な支配を確立するまで、長くてもあと1年。それまでに、強大な力を蓄えなければならない。

column3: With your realm destroyed by undead, the only way to gain enough power to drive them back someday is to capture castle Visimir!!!!
column4: You have no hope against the necromancers without the Barbarians castles and resources-you must attack them and take Visimir.  Then and only then will you have enough power to even think of attacking the undead hordes
column5: バーバリアンの城と資源なくして、ネクロマンサーに勝つ望みはない。彼らを攻め、ヴィシミールを奪え。それだけの力を手にして初めて、アンデッドの大軍との戦いが見えてくる。

column3: With your realm destroyed by undead, the only way to gain enough power to drive them back someday is to capture castle Visimir!!!!
column4: The Necromancers have expanded their reign of tyranny, and now have a working kingdom.  They will soon be pushing out to gain the rest of the land!  Take Visimir!!!
column5: ネクロマンサーは圧政の版図を広げ、今や一つの王国を築き上げた。やがて残る土地を求め、進軍を始めるだろう。ヴィシミールを奪え！

column3: With your realm destroyed by undead, the only way to gain enough power to drive them back someday is to capture castle Visimir!!!!
column4: It is over!!!!!! You woke up in the middle of the night to hear the castle in an uproar.  When you look out your minaret window, you see 1000's of skeletons, zombies, vampires, and even more hideous creatures routing your army.  Soon they have taken the walls, and have you captured.  It is all over... the Necromancers have finally destroyed the last living things in the world, and chaos reigns supreme!!!!
column5: すべて終わりだ！ 真夜中、城内の騒ぎで目を覚ました。塔の窓から外を見ると、何千ものスケルトン、ゾンビ、ヴァンパイア、そして名状しがたい怪物たちが、あなたの軍を蹴散らしている。ほどなく城壁は破られ、あなたも捕らえられた。すべては終わった……ネクロマンサーはついに、この世界に残る最後の命まで滅ぼした。今や混沌がすべてを支配している！

column3: With your realm destroyed by undead, the only way to gain enough power to drive them back someday is to capture castle Visimir!!!!
column4: Just capture castle Visimir to win-worry about the undead later!!!
column5: ヴィシミール城さえ奪えば勝利だ。アンデッドのことは後で考えればいい！

column3: With your realm destroyed by undead, the only way to gain enough power to drive them back someday is to capture castle Visimir!!!!
column4: You must flee immediately if you have any hope of survival.  Your heroes are no match for the powerful Necromancers that now rule Alteris.  There is a resource-rich island to the north that may get you off to a good start, but you will need more resources to build up an army big enough to attack the Death King.
column5: 生き延びたいなら、今すぐ逃げろ。あなたの英雄たちでは、今のアルテリスを支配する強大なネクロマンサーに歯が立たない。北には資源豊かな島がある。再起の足掛かりにはなるだろうが、死の王を攻められるほどの軍を築くには、さらに多くの資源が必要だ。

column3: With your realm destroyed by undead, the only way to gain enough power to drive them back someday is to capture castle Visimir!!!!
column4: Your royal advisors remind you of the vicious Barbarians to the north.  They have been your bitter enemies to this day, but may agree to ally with you against the Necromancer hordes.  Even if they don't ally with you, controlling their resource-rich land is very important.
column5: 王室の助言者たちが、北方の凶暴なバーバリアンについて改めて忠告した。彼らは長年の宿敵だが、ネクロマンサーの大軍に対抗するためなら同盟に応じるかもしれない。たとえ同盟を拒まれても、資源豊かな彼らの領土を支配することは極めて重要だ。

column3: With your realm destroyed by undead, the only way to gain enough power to drive them back someday is to capture castle Visimir!!!!
column4: The second you reach the other side of the portal, you realize you are in a new land.  High mountains rise to your north and east.  Ahead is a huge canyon.  Off in the distance, you see a Bridge across the canyon, but it is impassable from here.  You also can feel that this place is magical.  A few minutes after arrival, an ancient shaman steps out of a previously unseen hut and hands you a wand!
column5: ポータルの向こう側へ足を踏み入れた瞬間、そこが見知らぬ土地だと気づいた。北と東には高い山々がそびえ、前方には巨大な峡谷が口を開けている。遠くには峡谷を渡る橋が見えるが、ここからでは通れそうにない。この地には不思議な魔力が満ちているのも感じられる。到着して数分後、それまで見えなかった小屋から年老いたシャーマンが現れ、あなたに杖を手渡した！

column3: With your realm destroyed by undead, the only way to gain enough power to drive them back someday is to capture castle Visimir!!!!
column4: Upon reaching the canyon edge, you look out to get a better view of the Bridge.  All of a sudden, a large group of trolls steps out onto the bridge, and yells something to you.  You step dangerously close to the edge to try and hear what they are saying, but to no avail.  All of a sudden, you start to slip off the edge of the precipice!! But, one of your loyal troops catches you.  You dropped your sack of spendable resources, losing everything.
column5: 峡谷の縁まで来たあなたは、橋をよく見ようと遠くを見渡した。すると突然、大勢のトロルが橋へ現れ、こちらに向かって何かを叫び始めた。言葉を聞き取ろうと危険なほど縁へ身を乗り出したが、やはり聞こえない。そのとき突然、足を滑らせて崖から落ちそうになった！ だが、忠実な兵士の一人があなたをつかまえた。代わりに、資源の入った袋を落とし、すべてを失ってしまった。

column3: With your realm destroyed by undead, the only way to gain enough power to drive them back someday is to capture castle Visimir!!!!
column4: The Undead hordes have destroyed your resource-rich land in a matter of days-you have only two heroes left.  Although these heroes are experienced, they are no match for the Necromancers that now rule the land.  You must leave this land at once, maybe never to return.  There is an island to the North-east where you may be able to develop a base, and maybe gain back your homeland.
column5: アンデッドの大軍は、わずか数日で資源豊かなあなたの国土を滅ぼした。残された勇者は、たった二人。二人とも経験豊かだが、今やこの地を支配するネクロマンサーには到底かなわない。今すぐこの地を離れなければならない。二度と戻れないかもしれない。北東には島があり、そこで拠点を築けば、いつか故郷を取り戻せるかもしれない。

column3: With your realm destroyed by undead, the only way to gain enough power to drive them back someday is to capture castle Visimir!!!!
column4: After sailing for many days, one night you grow restless.  You remember your homeland and dream of what life would be like there.  You go up to the deck and look out across the black waters.  As you look, you see something catch the glint of the moonlight.  You lower a canoe and find a beautiful necklace.
column5: 何日も航海を続けたある夜、あなたは落ち着かない気持ちに駆られた。故郷を思い出し、そこで暮らしていたころの生活を夢見る。甲板へ出て暗い海を眺めていると、何かが月明かりを反射して輝いた。小舟を下ろして調べると、美しい首飾りを見つけた。

column3: With your realm destroyed by undead, the only way to gain enough power to drive them back someday is to capture castle Visimir!!!!
column4: Up ahead, you see a beacon of light.  Somehow you gain the confidence that you are heading in the right direction and may prevail, someday.
column5: 前方に、一筋の光が見える。不思議なことに、自分は正しい方向へ進んでおり、いつか必ず勝利できるという確信が湧いてきた。

column3: With your realm destroyed by undead, the only way to gain enough power to drive them back someday is to capture castle Visimir!!!!
column4: After landing on a curious island, you see a Mansion up ahead.  "What is a mansion doing out here in the middle of nowhere?" You say aloud to yourself.  You have no idea if the owners are hospitable, but you are tired and hungry, so you hurry toward the front gate...
column5: 不思議な島へ上陸すると、前方に大きな邸宅が見えた。「こんな辺境に、なぜ邸宅が？」思わず独り言が漏れる。住人が客を歓迎するかは分からない。だが、疲れ果て空腹だったあなたは、正門へと急いだ……。

column3: With your realm destroyed by undead, the only way to gain enough power to drive them back someday is to capture castle Visimir!!!!
column4: The undead have even been here?? How long will it be before they have everything??
column5: アンデッドは、ここにまで来ていたのか？ 奴らがすべてを手にするまで、あとどれほど残されている？

column3: With your realm destroyed by undead, the only way to gain enough power to drive them back someday is to capture castle Visimir!!!!
column4: As you get out of your ship, you notice a strange grove of palm trees in the middle of the isle.  Inside the grove, you find a dying Mage.  As he dies, he says "Thank you for coming to visit me, you are the first ones in ages.  I will give you the last of my magical powers>"
column5: 船を降りると、島の中央に奇妙なヤシの木立があることに気づいた。木立の中で、瀕死のメイジを見つける。彼は息を引き取る間際に言った。「会いに来てくれてありがとう。こんな訪問者は何年ぶりだろう。私に残された最後の魔力を、あなたに授けよう」

column3: With your realm destroyed by undead, the only way to gain enough power to drive them back someday is to capture castle Visimir!!!!
column4: As you reach the island, your scouts return from surveying the land.  They say it is resource-rich, even enough to start a suitable city.  Will it be enough to gain back your homeland??  Only time will tell, but for now it is your only hope
column5: 島へたどり着くと、土地を調べていた斥候たちが戻ってきた。報告によれば、この島は資源が豊富で、都市を築くにも十分だという。故郷を取り戻すだけの力を得られるだろうか？ それは時が教えてくれる。だが今は、ここが唯一の希望だ。

column3: With your realm destroyed by undead, the only way to gain enough power to drive them back someday is to capture castle Visimir!!!!
column4: One of your advisors reminds you of the vicious barbarians of the north.  Although you have been bitter enemies in the past, maybe if they were notified of the Undead invasion, they would form an alliance with us.  You immediately send a diplomat to their region.  They could help turn the tide of the war if you get that far.
column5: 助言者の一人が、北方の凶暴なバーバリアンについて念を押した。彼らとは長年敵対してきたが、アンデッドの侵攻を知らせれば同盟を結ぶかもしれない。あなたはただちに外交官を彼らの領地へ送り出した。彼らのもとへたどり着ければ、その助力で戦況を覆せるかもしれない。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: So far, you've made great progress with your diplomatic efforts this year.  You and the sorceress Queen Dawnstar have forged a strong alliance, uniting the powers of the North.  You sent an ambassador south to make peace with the Wizard King Flintlok.  She sends word back that, while she has made some contacts, she isn't sure if this King Flintlok will be willing to make peace...
column5: 今年、君の外交努力はここまで大きな成果を上げてきた。君はソーサレスのドーンスター女王と強固な同盟を結び、北方の勢力を一つにまとめた。南方のウィザード王フリントロックとの和平を求め、大使も送り出している。彼女からは、いくつかのつては得たものの、フリントロック王が和平に応じるかは定かでないとの知らせが届いた……。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: The message from the south is clear.  "We do not make peace with the filth of creation," says King Flintlok.  "You are a blemish upon the pristine face of our ideal kingdom.  We shall mass a force and send it north to crush you like the filthy insect that you are.  Wait in your icy cave and tremble, Necromancer - you will never escape our justice."
column5: 南方からの返答は明白だった。「我らは、創造の汚物と和平など結ばぬ」とフリントロック王は言う。「貴様は、我らが理想の王国の清らかな姿を汚す醜い染みだ。軍勢を集めて北へ進み、汚らわしい虫けらのごとく踏み潰してくれる。凍てつく洞窟で震えて待つがよい、ネクロマンサーよ。我らの裁きから逃れることはできぬ」

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: Of course you know, THIS means WAR.
column5: 言うまでもない。これは戦争だ。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: Your alliance with the Necromancer Lord Falat is a great victory for peace.  Now that the powers of the North are united, you have sent an envoy south to treat for peace with the Warlocks as well.  Though initial reports from your ambassador are moderately promising, you get the feeling that the Warlocks may not be so eager to make peace with you...
column5: ネクロマンサー卿ファラットとの同盟は、平和への大きな勝利だ。北方の勢力が一つにまとまった今、君はウォーロックとも和平を結ぶため、南方へ使節を送った。大使からの第一報はまずまずだったが、ウォーロックたちが君との和平に乗り気だとは思えない……。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: The report from the south is worse than you feared.  "We do not parlay with women and fools," Dragonking Rhegar says.  "We are Blood of the Dragon!  You skulking vermin of the North are nothing to us.  If you bow down before us, we may give you a clean, quick death.  If not, you shall writhe in agony as the flames of the dragon sear your soft flesh from your bones!"
column5: 南方からの返答は、恐れていた以上にひどいものだった。「女や愚か者と交渉はせぬ」とドラゴン王レイガーは言う。「我らは竜の血を引く者！ 北方を這い回る害虫など、取るに足らぬ。ひれ伏すなら、苦しまずに死なせてやろう。拒むなら、竜の炎が柔らかな肉を骨から焼き落とすまで、苦痛にのたうち回るがよい！」

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: So much for peace.  Looks like you're going to have to go south and teach these chauvinistic pigs a few lessons in respect.
column5: 和平交渉はご破算だ。南へ進み、あの男尊女卑の豚どもに礼儀というものを教えてやるしかない。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: Neutral Kings don't build, but they do buy troops.
column5: 中立の王は建物を建てないが、兵は買う。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: It would appear that your ally, Queen Dawnstar, has made an enemy of the Dragonking Rhegar.  That's fine... you never liked the warlocks very much anyway. War has come to the North - might as well go all the way with it.
column5: どうやら君の盟友、ドーンスター女王がドラゴン王レイガーを敵に回したらしい。構わない……もともとウォーロックは好きではなかった。北方に戦争が訪れたのなら、こうなった以上、とことん戦うまでだ。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: As if the Warlocks weren't trouble enough, it seems that your ally, the Necromancer Lord Falat, has made an enemy of the Wizard King Flintlok.  Well, you were probably going to cross swords with those overbearing, self-righteous tyrants anyway.  In for a penny, in for a pound - war has come, and the North shall prevail.
column5: ウォーロックだけでも厄介だというのに、君の盟友であるネクロマンサー卿ファラットが、ウィザード王フリントロックを敵に回したらしい。もっとも、あの尊大で独善的な暴君とは、いずれ剣を交えることになっていただろう。戦争は始まった。こうなれば最後まで戦い、北方が勝利を収めるのだ。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: News from the ocean front - the warrior lords of the Blood Banner have thrown in with your enemies.  This not good news - these warlords are fierce and have powerful armies at their command.  It looks like you'll have to fight your way through their Arenas of Blood to get to the sea.
column5: 海方面から知らせが届いた。血の旗を掲げる戦士諸侯が、君の敵に加勢したという。これは悪い知らせだ。彼らは獰猛な戦王で、強大な軍勢を従えている。海へ出るには、彼らの「血の闘技場」を戦い抜かなければならないようだ。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: The sea is littered with tiny island kingdoms, the Neutral Lords of the Golden Banner, who refuse to commit to either side.  You and your allies will have to bend these lords to your will if victory is to be yours.  The Golden Lords will be quiescent until attacked, but once roused, they may become hostile and aggressive...
column5: 海には、黄金の旗を掲げる中立諸侯が治める小さな島国が点在している。彼らは、どちらの陣営にも加わろうとしない。勝利を望むなら、君と盟友たちは彼らを従わせなければならない。黄金の諸侯は攻撃されるまで動かないが、ひとたび目を覚ませば、敵意をむき出しにして襲いかかってくるかもしれない……。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: The handless Lord Brackenthorn, grateful for your alliance, sends you loot he and his fugitive family have stolen from the tyrant king Flintlok.
column5: 同盟への感謝を込め、両手を失ったブラッケンソーン卿が、逃亡中の一族とともに暴君フリントロック王から盗み出した戦利品を君に送ってきた。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: The fugitive Lady Cimmera, grateful for your aid and support, sends to you resources and goods stolen from the Dragonking.
column5: 君の援助と支えに感謝した逃亡中のシメラ夫人が、ドラゴン王から盗み出した資源や物資を送ってきた。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: The computer is too stupid.
column5: コンピューターは頭が悪すぎる。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: A message from Dragonking Rhegar comes to you.  "I am at war with your ally, yet you and I have no reason to quarrel.  Do not interfere with my conflict with Dawnstar, and perhaps we can become allies.  A token of my royal esteem for your dark empire may convince you of the wisdom of what I say..."
column5: ドラゴン王レイガーから伝言が届いた。「余はそなたの盟友と戦っているが、そなたと争う理由はない。ドーンスターとの戦いに介入しなければ、いずれ同盟を結ぶこともできよう。そなたの闇の帝国へ敬意を示すこの贈り物が、余の言葉の賢明さを伝えてくれるはずだ……」

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: A messenger bird from the Wizard King Flintlok reaches you.  "Though we are at war with thine ally, Falat, we have not determined that thou art evil.  Abandon any efforts to aid this Necromancer, and thou shalt be deemed worthy in our eyes.  This token of our royal esteem is for the promise of thy loyalty..."
column5: ウィザード王フリントロックの伝書鳥が君のもとへ届いた。「我らはそなたの盟友ファラットと戦っているが、そなたまで邪悪だと決めつけたわけではない。あのネクロマンサーへの助力をすべて断つなら、そなたを我らにふさわしき者と認めよう。この王家からの贈り物は、そなたの忠誠の約束に対する敬意のしるしだ……」

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: Word from the West reaches you that your enemy, King Flintlok, has sent one of his most powerful generals to help the red Barbarian Lord, Blood Badger.  This general Astoria has an army of giants and magi... she may be more likely to venture forth and strike at you than Blood Badger, who prefers to stay in his Arena.
column5: 西方から知らせが届いた。敵であるフリントロック王が、赤のバーバリアン卿ブラッド・バジャーを援護するため、最強の将軍の一人を送り込んだという。将軍アストリアはジャイアントとメイジの軍勢を率いている……闘技場にこもるのを好むブラッド・バジャーよりも、積極的に進軍して君へ攻撃を仕掛けてくるだろう。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: Your agents from the East report that the DragonKing has sent his feared agent, the Warlock Apoplexy, to aid the Blood Lords.   Apoplexy has brought Dragons to the north, and will probably be more daring in his attacks than Blood Lizard, who prefers to stay in his arena...
column5: 東方の密偵から報告が届いた。ドラゴン王が、恐るべき配下のウォーロック、アポプレキシーを血の領主たちの援軍として送り込んだという。アポプレキシーはドラゴンを北方へ連れてきた。闘技場にこもるのを好むブラッド・リザードよりも、大胆に攻撃を仕掛けてくるだろう……。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: You've been trying, with little success, to make alliances with some of the Free Island Kingdoms.  Queen Eliza, the Medusa Queen, declines your offer of a treaty, but she does send a minstrel from her island to entertain you.  That alone seems like an act of open hostility.  You pay for the Minstrel's journey home, wondering if Eliza is actually still sane after listening to that...
column5: 君は自由諸島のいくつかの王国と同盟を結ぼうとしてきたが、ほとんど成果は上がっていない。メデューサの女王イライザも条約の申し出を断ったが、代わりに君を楽しませようと、島から吟遊詩人を送ってきた。その歌だけでも、公然たる敵対行為に思えるほどだった。君は吟遊詩人の帰路の費用を払いながら、あの歌を聞き続けたイライザが今も正気なのか疑わしく思った……。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: Your diplomatic efforts with the Free Island Kings aren't yielding results.  King Ronnie of the Centaurs won't sign your treaty, but he does send you a ponderous book of his wisest anecdotes.  It comes C.O.D., so you get stuck with the shipping costs.  The book itself reads like the worst sort of Steinbeck drivel, and you throw it away after the first chapter.
column5: 自由諸島の王たちに対する外交努力は、成果を生んでいない。ケンタウロスのロニー王も条約への署名を拒んだが、自らの英知を集めたという重々しい逸話集を送ってきた。しかも代引きだったため、君が送料を払う羽目になった。本の中身は、できの悪いスタインベック作品のような駄文で、君は第1章を読んだだけで捨ててしまった。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: Still no luck with peace treaties.  The free Dragonking F'lar does send you a token of friendship - a collection of hand-crafted knives and a list of the people he's gouged with them - but he won't sign a treaty.  At least you can sell the knives to a collector.
column5: 和平条約は、相変わらず実を結ばない。独立ドラゴン王フラーは友情のしるしとして、手作りのナイフ一式と、それで目をえぐった者たちの名簿を送ってきたが、条約への署名は拒んだ。少なくとも、ナイフは収集家に売れるだろう。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: You thought there might be a chance of a treaty with the Dwarf King Oakenshield, but no such luck.  The dwarves wish to remain neutral - you suspect they're just too lazy to be bothered, the stumpy little rascals.  Still, they send you some very nice gifts as a token of friendship, which is better than nothing.
column5: ドワーフ王オーケンシールドとは条約を結べるかもしれないと思っていたが、やはり駄目だった。ドワーフたちは中立を保ちたいという。あのずんぐりした悪党どもは、面倒事を嫌っているだけなのではないかと君は疑っている。それでも友情のしるしとして、なかなか立派な贈り物を送ってきた。何もないよりはましだ。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: The amazing Dick Saucer holds a surprise concert.  You weren't even expecting to see him in this campaign!  The economy benefits greatly.
column5: 驚異のディック・ソーサーが、サプライズコンサートを開いた。まさか、この戦いで彼に会えるとは思わなかった！ 経済は大いに潤った。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: You had hoped that the Lich King Strathern would sign a treaty, but he declines your offer, claiming that he's far too busy with pension plans, benefit programs, and day care centers to join in a war.  You had no idea that Liches want such things, but your own Liches admit that they're concerned about their families' future.  You put some money aside for them.
column5: リッチ王ストラザーンが条約に署名してくれると期待していたが、彼は申し出を断った。年金制度や福利厚生、保育所のことで忙しく、戦争に加わる余裕などないという。リッチがそんなものを望むとは思いもしなかったが、君の配下のリッチたちも家族の将来を案じていると打ち明けた。君は彼らのために、いくらかの金を積み立てることにした。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: You finally give up negotiating with the Free Alliance States.  All their special committees, their due process, their voting schedules... it just wears you out and sucks up your money.  This "democracy" business is for the birds, you conclude.
column5: 君はついに、自由同盟国との交渉を諦めた。特別委員会だの、適正な手続きだの、投票日程だの……あれこれ振り回され、金を吸い取られただけだった。「民主主義」など、くだらないものだと君は結論づけた。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: Okay, you bonehead computers.  You should have lots of Black Towers and Cloud Castles by now, but you AREN'T buying the troops!  Here.  Buy troops.  Try to make a reasonable showing of it, okay?  Pathetic machine...
column5: いいか、この間抜けなコンピューターども。もう黒い塔や雲の宮殿がいくつも建っているはずなのに、まるで兵を買っていないではないか！ ほら、これで兵を買え。少しはまともに戦ってみせろ。まったく、情けない機械だ……。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: Here's a sight you never hoped to see - Dragons in the North!  It would seem that Rhegar is attempting to win the barbarians over with dragons and fire.  So much for his proposed alliance with you, the two-faced vermin.  Warlock bones are as good as Wizard bones to you - you'll make good use of them all!
column5: 目にしたくもなかった光景だ――北方にドラゴンがいる！ レイガーはドラゴンと炎を餌に、バーバリアンを味方へ引き入れようとしているらしい。君との同盟話など口先だけだったのだ、この二枚舌の下衆め。ウォーロックの骨もウィザードの骨も、君には同じように役に立つ。どちらも存分に使ってやろう！

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: Now, THIS really ticks you off - King Flintlok has violated the sanctity of your borders and sent his Giants up here to hold Antioch against you.  That backstabbing, blue-faced swine... so much for his promise to leave you alone!  Now, he and those DragonKing scum are both going to catch it from you...
column5: まったく、腹立たしいことこの上ない。フリントロック王は神聖な君の国境を侵犯し、アンティオキアを占拠させるためジャイアントを送り込んできた！ あの裏切り者の青面豚め……君には手を出さないという約束はどうした！ こうなれば、奴もドラゴン王の屑どももまとめて思い知らせてやる……。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: The captain of the legendary fortress Whiteshield calls to you.  "The tyrant king Flintlok has disgraced the order of Wizards, making a mockery of the ideals we hold dear.  If you prove your worth in combat, we will aid you with what knowledge and power we can in your quest to return true justice to the world!"
column5: 伝説の砦ホワイトシールドの隊長が、君に呼びかけた。「暴君フリントロック王はウィザードの名を汚し、我らが尊ぶ理想を踏みにじった。戦いでその力を示すなら、真の正義を世に取り戻す君の戦いに、我らの知識と力をもって助力しよう！」

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: You enter the legendary valley of Whiteshield with a certain degree of trepidation... the Wizards of the south are your enemies.  The northern Wizards are said to be wise and just, but are they really any better than their bloodthirsty counterparts?
column5: 君は幾分の不安を胸に、伝説のホワイトシールド渓谷へ足を踏み入れた……。南方のウィザードは君の敵だ。北方のウィザードは賢明で公正だといわれるが、果たして血に飢えた南方の同胞より本当にましなのだろうか？

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: You see the bones of yet another victim of the terrible Blood Lords before you.  You can tell it's one of their victims, because they have this tendency to write "Victim of the Blood Lords" all over the surrounding rocks in blood.  They're sort of obsessed with blood, these guys.
column5: またしても、恐るべき血の領主たちの犠牲者の骨を見つけた。奴らの仕業だとすぐに分かる。周囲の岩という岩に、血で「血の領主の犠牲者」と書き殴る癖があるからだ。こいつら、血に取り憑かれているらしい。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: You see before you the skull of another victim of the army of Blood Lizard... he sure likes to kill minotaurs.  Perhaps that's how the DragonKings made their alliance, by providing Blood Lizard with a continuous supply of minotaurs to satisfy his appetite for slaughter.  Have these evil jerks no shame at all?
column5: 目の前に、ブラッド・リザード軍の新たな犠牲者の頭蓋骨が転がっている……。奴は本当にミノタウロスを殺すのが好きらしい。ドラゴン王たちは、殺戮欲を満たせるだけのミノタウロスを絶えず差し出して、ブラッド・リザードと同盟を結んだのかもしれない。あの邪悪な下衆どもには、恥というものがないのか？

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: The Witch-King of the orcs and goblins materializes before you.  "I may not have the power to face you in combat, but I can still put a curse on you for violating my realm.  Here, have a Hideous Mask!"  Quickly, you reach out and pluck her eyeball out instead.  She disappears with a screech of surprise.
column5: オークとゴブリンの魔女王が君の前に現れた。「戦って君を倒す力はないかもしれないが、我が領地を侵した罰として呪いをかけることはできる。ほら、この石仮面を受け取れ！」君は素早く手を伸ばし、代わりに彼女の目玉をえぐり取った。魔女王は驚きの悲鳴を上げて消え去った。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: An old troll woman approaches you.  "I carved this likeness of our Lord Splorch for you, my master..." She's about to give you a hideous mask!  Quickly, you chop her head off and punt her ugly statue away.  Later, you sell the head for a nice profit to a local collector.
column5: 年老いたトロルの女が近づいてきた。「我らがスプローチ卿のお姿を、あなた様のために彫りました、ご主人様……」なんと、石仮面を渡そうとしている！ 君はすかさず女の首をはね、醜い像を蹴り飛ばした。後に、その首を地元の収集家へ売り、かなりの利益を得た。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: As you're searching for some nice place to take a lunch break, a thief rushes from the woods.  "Here," he says, thrusting a bag towards you, "I stole this from King Ronnie for you!"  You can tell from the contours of the bag that it contains a Hideous Mask, so you immediately fry the thief with a lightning bolt.  Inspection reveals a few other valuables on his person.
column5: 昼食を取れそうな場所を探していると、森から盗賊が飛び出してきた。「これを」と袋を押しつけ、「ロニー王から盗んできました！」袋の形から石仮面が入っていると分かった君は、即座に盗賊を稲妻で焼き払った。所持品を調べると、ほかにもいくつか金目の物が見つかった。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: Look, says the hobbit mayor, "we're a Democracy here!  We're not going to follow some self-appointed king without a vote."  He then catches sight of the size of your army.  "Of course, I do intend to vote for you.  Um, when would be a convenient time for an election, then?"  You leave him to sort out the details.
column5: 「いいですか」とホビットの町長が言う。「ここは民主国家です！ 投票もせず、勝手に王を名乗る者に従うつもりはありません」だが、彼は君の軍勢の規模に気づいた。「もちろん、私はあなたに投票するつもりです。ええと……選挙はいつにすればご都合よろしいでしょうか？」君は細かいことを彼に任せ、その場を後にした。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: A stooped old man approaches.  "When you are burned with the flames of the dragon, your face will look like this!"  He tries to put a Hideous Mask on you but you deftly pound him on the head with a convenient rock.  Later, you notice the rock you picked up is big chunk of quartz that you might be able to use for something.
column5: 背を丸めた老人が近づいてきた。「ドラゴンの炎に焼かれれば、お前の顔もこうなるぞ！」老人は君に石仮面をかぶせようとするが、君は手近な岩で素早く頭を殴りつけた。後になって、拾った岩が大きな水晶の塊で、何かに使えそうだと気づいた。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: A mummy shambles towards you, shouting, "The curse... of the mummy!"  As it attempts to plop a Hideous Mask onto your head, you grab the edge of a bandage and give a hard yank.  The whole thing unravels, leaving behind only its very nice jewelry and a ring.
column5: ミイラがよろめきながら近づき、「ミイラの……呪いだ！」と叫んだ。石仮面を君の頭に載せようとしたところで、君は包帯の端をつかみ、勢いよく引っ張った。包帯はすべてほどけ、あとには上等な宝飾品と指輪だけが残った。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: Funny... there are a bunch of very lifelike statues on this island, all of people in poses of sheer terror.  Maybe some demented sculptor works here... although how anybody could work with ALL THIS DAMNED RACKET is anybody's guess...
column5: 妙だ……この島には、恐怖に引きつった姿勢の、やけに生々しい彫像がいくつもある。頭のおかしい彫刻家でも住んでいるのだろうか……もっとも、このひどい騒音の中でどうやって仕事ができるのか、まったく見当もつかない……。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: This singing is really starting to get on your nerves.  You start considering new artifacts.  "Earplugs of Domination?"  "Ghetto Blaster of Power?"  "Mage's Earmuffs of Protection?"  Anything to keep your mind off the bloody noise...
column5: この歌声には本当にいらいらしてきた。君は新しいアーティファクトをあれこれ考え始める。「支配の耳栓？」「力の爆音ラジカセ？」「守護の魔道師用耳当て？」何でもいい、この忌々しい騒音から気をそらしたい……。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: A traveling salesman comes to you.  "Hey," he says, "I've got something you can wear to help muffle that sound!"  He ALMOST gets you to put on the Hideous Mask, but you catch yourself at the last instant.  You tie him to a tree where he'll have to listen to the singing until he goes mad.  You take his belongings and find a nice pouch.
column5: 行商人が近づいてきた。「なあ、この音を和らげるのにちょうどいい被り物があるんだ！」危うく石仮面をかぶせられそうになったが、君は間一髪で我に返った。君は行商人を木に縛りつけ、気が狂うまで歌を聞かせることにした。所持品を奪うと、立派な袋が見つかった。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: Attracted to the rocks by some truly dreadful singing, you discover a family of mermaids who are trying to form a music band.  Gritting your teeth, you offer a few kind words of praise for their singing.  They're so happy that they give you a gift in gratitude.
column5: あまりにひどい歌声に引き寄せられて岩場へ行くと、音楽隊を結成しようとしている人魚の一家を見つけた。君は歯を食いしばり、歌を少しだけ褒めてやった。彼女たちは大喜びし、お礼に贈り物をくれた。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: A dreadful racket attracts your curiosity.  As you explore these rocks, you discover a family of mermaids who are practicing for a concert.  As politely as you can, you tell them that their music makes you want to gag.  They retreat to the depths, discouraged.  A grateful music critic sends you a gift of thanks.
column5: ひどい騒音に興味を引かれ、岩場を調べてみると、演奏会に向けて練習している人魚の一家を見つけた。君はできるだけ丁寧に、その音楽を聞くと吐き気がすると伝えた。意気消沈した彼女たちは海の底へ戻っていった。後に、感謝した音楽評論家から礼の品が届いた。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: A fat merchant approaches.  "The archers have crafted this clever headgear to help them aim their bows.  Perhaps you'd like to try it?"  The headgear is clearly a Hideous Mask.  You confiscate all his valuables and hurl him off a nearby cliff with his stupid mask.  He has a rather nice pouch, you discover.
column5: 太った商人が近づいてきた。「弓兵たちが狙いを定めやすくするため、この便利な被り物を作ったのです。試してみませんか？」どう見ても石仮面だ。君は商人の金目の物をすべて没収し、馬鹿げた仮面もろとも近くの崖から放り投げた。調べてみると、なかなか立派な袋を持っていた。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: A suspicious-looking dwarf approaches you.  "Here, m'lord," he says, "a token of my fealty.  It is the finest dwarvish craftmanship!"  You knock him down and kick open his package - sure enough, it's a Hideous Mask.  You cut off his fool head, and have some true Dwarf craftsmen make a very nice helmet out of it.
column5: 怪しげなドワーフが近づいてきた。「さあ、閣下」と彼は言う。「忠誠のしるしです。ドワーフ最高の職人技で作られております！」君は彼を殴り倒し、包みを蹴り開けた。案の定、石仮面だ。君はその愚かな頭を切り落とし、本物のドワーフ職人に立派な兜へ仕立てさせた。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: The Peasant Leader comes to you.  "Here, m'lord!  This is our finest treasure, and we give it to you!"  It's a Hideous Mask.  You have no doubt that it IS their finest treasure, though.  Feeling merciful, you decide to spare their lives and merely tear down their houses and sell them into slavery.
column5: 農民たちの長が近づいてきた。「どうぞ、閣下！ 我らの最高の宝を差し上げます！」石仮面だ。もっとも、これが本当に彼らの最高の宝であることは疑いようもない。慈悲深い気分になった君は命だけは助け、家を取り壊して奴隷に売るだけで済ませることにした。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: A strange old doctor approaches you.  "In this desert heat, you need protective headgear!  Here, try this..." You grab his wrist as he is about to put a Hideous Mask on you.  After you've disposed of him, you discover that he has some nice thermometers in his bag, full of Mercury.
column5: 奇妙な老医師が近づいてきた。「この砂漠の暑さでは、頭を守る物が必要です！ さあ、これを……」石仮面をかぶせようとしたところで、君は彼の手首をつかんだ。始末したあとで袋を調べると、水銀の入った上等な体温計がいくつか見つかった。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: You come upon a Lich family playing in the sand.  "Mommy, look what I found!" the young Lich says.  Quickly, you rush in and knock the thing away - it was a Hideous Mask!  The Lich family is so grateful that they give you a gift as a token of their thanks.
column5: 砂遊びをしているリッチの一家に出会った。「ママ、見て！ こんなの見つけた！」幼いリッチが言う。君が駆け寄ってそれを払い落とすと、なんと石仮面だった！ リッチの一家は大いに感謝し、お礼に贈り物をくれた。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: Well, this is just terrific.  These intolerant iron-fisted Wizards have not only refused to hear your peace offer, they've thrown you in prison!  Now you await the so-called "King's Justice," for crimes they refuse to even explain to you.  This is not going to sit very well with your lord when you return...
column5: まったく、素晴らしいことになった。この不寛容で強権的なウィザードどもは、和平の申し出を聞くことすら拒んだうえ、君を牢へ放り込んだ！ 今や君は、何の罪かすら説明されないまま、いわゆる「王の裁き」を待っている。帰還したとき、この話を聞いて君の主君が黙っているはずはない……。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: You have some small experience as a diplomat, and you don't think this is a good sign.  You've been thrown into the high tower to await the "justice" of the Dragonlord.  Something was mentioned about your head on a spike.  You get the sneaking suspicion that there isn't going to be a treaty after all...
column5: 君にも外交官として多少の経験はある。そして、これは良い兆候ではないと思う。君は高塔へ投げ込まれ、ドラゴン卿の「裁き」を待つ身となった。君の首を杭にさらすという話も聞こえてきた。どうやら、結局条約は結べそうにない……。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: When the last lord of House Cimmera died before leaving a male heir, the Dragonking Rhegar declared that the line had become weak.  All holdings were stripped from the Cimmera clan, and their ancestral castle was burned to the ground.  Now, you have aided them in rebuilding their lost home.  In return, House Cimmera will help you by spying on, stealing from, and harassing the Dragonkings for as long as they can.
column5: シメラ家最後の当主が男子の後継者を残さずに亡くなると、ドラゴン王レイガーはその血筋が弱体化したと宣言した。シメラ一族は全領地を奪われ、先祖伝来の城も焼き払われた。今、君は彼らが失われた故郷を再建するのを助けた。その恩に報いるため、シメラ家は力の続く限り、ドラゴン王たちへの諜報、窃盗、妨害で君を支援してくれる。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: When Lord Brackenthorn was a child of five, he was caught stealing a piece of fruit by the Wizard's Guard.  King Flintlok had both the boy's hands cut off.  House Brackenthorn has fallen to shame and ruin.  In return for your help in rebuilding their decayed home, the Brackenthorns will help you in your crusade against the Wizard Kings, in whatever way they are able...
column5: ブラッケンソーン卿が5歳の頃、果物を一つ盗んだところをウィザードの近衛兵に捕らえられた。フリントロック王は少年の両手を切り落とさせた。ブラッケンソーン家は恥辱と没落の中に沈んだ。荒れ果てた故郷の再建を助けた恩に報いるため、彼らは可能な限り、ウィザード王たちに対する君の戦いを支援してくれる……。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: Before she retreats into hiding, Lady Cimmera gives you this device her daughter created, hoping it will aid you in your endeavors.
column5: 隠れ家へ退く前に、シメラ夫人は娘が作ったこの装置を君に渡し、今後の助けになればと願った。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: Lord Brackenthorn is retreating into hiding as the war gets underway, but he gives you this last heirloom his House, hoping it will aid you in your efforts...
column5: 戦争が始まるとブラッケンソーン卿は身を隠すことにしたが、その前に、君の助けとなることを願って一族最後の家宝を渡してくれた……。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: A group of terrified people flee across the snowy wastes. They tell you that ghosts have invaded their peaceful valley and taken over their gold mine. They beg for your help and pledge their undying loyalty to you.
column5: 怯えた人々の一団が雪原を逃げてきた。亡霊たちが彼らの平和な谷へ侵入し、金鉱を奪ったという。彼らは君に助けを請い、永遠の忠誠を誓った。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: A group of terrified people wanders across the snow. They tell you that ghosts have invaded their peaceful valley and taken over their watchtower. They beg you to help them and pledge their fealty to you.
column5: 怯えた人々の一団が雪原をさまよっている。亡霊たちが彼らの平和な谷へ侵入し、見張り塔を奪ったという。彼らは君に助けを請い、臣従を誓った。

column3: Your diplomats have been attacked... this means war!
column4: A strange wizened old man comes to you. He begs forgiveness for his sins and gives you a gift wrapped in old leather. He asks that you use this gift to save  a haunted valley south of here.
column5: 奇妙な、しわだらけの老人が君のもとへやってきた。自らの罪の赦しを請い、古びた革に包まれた贈り物を差し出した。そして、南にある亡霊に取り憑かれた谷を救うため、この贈り物を使ってほしいと頼んだ。

column3: Four lords vie for control of a forestland full of dragons and vagabonds.  Oracle tourn. version.  Re-edited by maker.
column4: It is the will of your king that this land, heretofore known only as the "Black Forest", becomes the next annex of his kingdom.  You and your army succeeded in ousting a local Dragonlord from his castle here but not before he burned it to the ground and escaped.  Now as you rebuild the castle and modify it for your purposes your spies report that some other lords have had the same idea as your king.  Now your enemies number more than a handful
column5: これまで「黒い森」とだけ呼ばれてきたこの地を、王国の新たな領土とせよ。それが君の王の意志だ。君と軍勢は、この地の城からドラゴン卿を追い出すことに成功した。だが彼は城を焼き払い、逃亡してしまった。君が城を再建し、自軍の拠点へ作り替えていると、密偵から報告が届いた。どうやら、ほかの領主たちも君の王と同じ考えらしい。今や君の敵は、一握りのドラゴンどころではない。

column3: Four lords vie for control of a forestland full of dragons and vagabonds.  Oracle tourn. version.  Re-edited by maker.
column4: of dragons. You must face the might of three other foes if you seek to control the Black Forest.  If matters weren't already difficult a rogue dragon has burned your mage guild to the ground in a surprise attack.  He waits outside your castle now, taunting your men with his fireballs and promising that your new life here will be made difficult by his kindred!
column5: 黒い森の支配を望むなら、さらに三人の強敵と対峙しなければならない。しかも困難はそれだけではなかった。はぐれドラゴンが奇襲を仕掛け、君の魔道師ギルドを焼き払ったのだ。そいつは今も城の外で待ち構え、兵士たちへファイアボールを放ちながら、仲間のドラゴンたちが君の新生活を苦難に満ちたものにしてやると挑発している！

column3: Four lords vie for control of a forestland full of dragons and vagabonds.  Oracle tourn. version.  Re-edited by maker.
column4: A nearby black dragon perched upon a large rock eyes you with an amused expression on his face.  A swirl of smoke rising from his snout forms into the image of a skull and something like a laugh escapes though his very sharp teeth.  He challenges you to a fight, pointing with one scaly black wing to a pile of gold nearby that will be yours....if you win.
column5: 近くの大岩に止まったブラックドラゴンが、面白そうな顔で君を見つめている。鼻先から立ち上る煙が渦を巻き、髑髏の形になった。鋭い牙の隙間から、笑い声のような音が漏れる。ドラゴンは鱗に覆われた黒い翼で近くの黄金の山を指し、それを賭けて戦えと君に挑んできた……勝てれば、あれは君のものだ。

column3: Four lords vie for control of a forestland full of dragons and vagabonds.  Oracle tourn. version.  Re-edited by maker.
column4: Rummaging through the remains of what used to be the favorite perch of a notoriously arrogant black dragon, you find a sword that looks like it could cut stone....and some other baubles.
column5: 悪名高い傲慢なブラックドラゴンのお気に入りの止まり場だった場所をあさると、石さえ切れそうな剣と……ほかにもいくつかの小さな宝物を見つけた。

column3: Four lords vie for control of a forestland full of dragons and vagabonds.  Oracle tourn. version.  Re-edited by maker.
column4: As you make your way along the forest road, the vegetation near the trees springs to life as a small horde of thieves concealed in holes beneath the brush ambush your party.  Before your men can react, you find a knife at your throat and their leader steps from the brush to confront you.  A handsome fellow, his grin is almost friendly.  "A few valuables are a small price to pay for your life, don't you agree?" They rob you blind.
column5: 森の道を進んでいると、木々のそばの草むらが突然動き出した。藪の下の穴に潜んでいた盗賊の一団が、君の部隊を待ち伏せしていたのだ。兵士たちが反応するより早く、君の喉元にナイフが突きつけられ、首領が茂みから姿を現した。端正な顔立ちの男で、その笑みは親しげにさえ見える。「命の代金なら、貴重品を少しばかり差し出すくらい安いものだ。そう思わないか？」奴らは君から根こそぎ奪っていった。

column3: Four lords vie for control of a forestland full of dragons and vagabonds.  Oracle tourn. version.  Re-edited by maker.
column4: The afternoon sun sits low in the sky almost invisible through the tree cover.  Perhaps that is why you do not see the thief swing across the road from a handy vine until it is too late.  In the time it took you to blink, he swung past you, taking your moneypurse with him on the end of his knife.  You turn your crossbow to the trees and cry out in shock and surprise.  Too late, the brazen thief is gone.
column5: 午後の太陽は空低くに傾き、木々の葉に遮られてほとんど見えない。だから、盗賊が手頃な蔓につかまって道を横切るまで気づかなかったのかもしれない。瞬きをする間に奴は君の前を飛び過ぎ、ナイフの先で金袋をさらっていった。驚きの声を上げながら木々へクロスボウを向けるが、もう遅い。大胆不敵な盗賊は消えていた。

column3: Four lords vie for control of a forestland full of dragons and vagabonds.  Oracle tourn. version.  Re-edited by maker.
column4: Making good progress along the forest road, you have occasion to see other travelers in small groups ambling in the opposite direction. Your party approaches a blind beggar, face shadowed by a cowl, cane tapping out his way along the roadside. Smiling, you lean down from your mount as you pass tendering a coin for his cup. He throws back his hood and pulls a crossbow from his robe. He robs you at boltpoint.
column5: 森の道を順調に進んでいると、反対方向へ歩く旅人の小さな一団と何度かすれ違った。やがて、頭巾で顔を隠し、杖で道端を探りながら歩く盲目の物乞いに近づいた。君は笑みを浮かべ、すれ違いざまに馬上から身をかがめ、椀へ硬貨を差し出す。すると物乞いは頭巾を跳ね上げ、衣の中からクロスボウを取り出した。君は矢を突きつけられ、金品を奪われた。

column3: Four lords vie for control of a forestland full of dragons and vagabonds.  Oracle tourn. version.  Re-edited by maker.
column4: You meet a young lad, Arioch, on the road who is travelling in the same direction.  He asks if he may join your party.  Arioch offers his services as a "fine cook" in return for protection from the "many bandits" who inhabit these parts. You consent, and that night he cooks an excellent repast from your rudimentary supplies.  In the morning your men complain of missing valuables. Arioch is missing and so are your saddlebags.
column5: 道中、同じ方向へ旅するアリオクという少年に出会った。彼は一行に加えてほしいと頼んできた。この辺りにいる「大勢の盗賊」から守ってもらう代わりに、「腕のよい料理人」として働くという。君が承諾すると、その晩、彼は乏しい食料から見事な食事を作ってみせた。翌朝、兵士たちが貴重品をなくしたと訴えてきた。アリオクの姿はなく、鞍袋も消えていた。
